notes.title: Help PULSOR Improve, comment your suggestions down below !
notes.notes:
I want PULSOR to be as good as it can be and with the help of feedback from the community, that can be a reality. If there is anything in the game that is annoying, you consider unfair or unbalanced, let me know.

if you have any suggestions for mechanics or game modes i would also be glad to hear them.

[b]Finally, if you enjoyed your time with PULSOR, please remember to leave a review, it helps me keep making games.[/b]

you can also join the discord [url=https://discord.gg/s3WwbuE]here[/url]

Have fun !

-RR

notes.title: PULSOR Is Ready !
notes.notes:
[b]Development for PULSOR is complete[/b] and the planned release is today with a 15% launch discount. I will continue to update PULSOR based on community feedback and possibly new game modes / content. 

Thanks for all the support !

-Dylan Robertson
